name: us-hamexam
description: Offline study app for the FCC Technician, General, and Extra amateur-radio exams

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:standalone && npm run test:storage:run && npm run test:pwa
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/exam-engine.test.js tests/unit/figure-references.test.js tests/unit/figure-manifest.test.js tests/unit/build-gate.test.js tests/unit/css-optimizer.test.js tests/unit/run-routine-tests.test.js tests/unit/pool-registry.test.js tests/unit/storage.test.js tests/unit/version-label.test.js tests/unit/check-generated.test.js tests/unit/workflow-policy.test.js tests/unit/routine-routing.test.js tests/unit/question-bank.test.js tests/unit/study-scope.test.js
scripts.test:storage: npm run build && npm run test:storage:run
scripts.check:generated: npm run build && npm run test:generated
